decisions.reason: As a newly launched printer close to the core portfolio, it should be kept because uncertainty is still high after one year while the cost of continuing to learn is likely low for this growing, R&D-active firm.

This new software module fits the firm's move toward digitalization and traceability, so management would keep the option open since it builds on existing capabilities and there is no clear evidence yet that its value will not materialize.

Because this coder extends the established marking offer into an attractive application area and has only been on the market briefly, the firm would keep it to gather more market information rather than abandon it early.
